form.label: Client → App → Hypervisor
form.description: One user action, correlated across four layers: Windows client, web-app container, and the Proxmox hypervisor.

html.h2: Tracing one action across four layers
html.p: The story: a user logs into Windows (London), opens the web-app running in an LXC container on the Proxmox hypervisor (Berlin), and clicks a button. This dashboard lines up all four layers.

ul.li: Correlation keys: src_ip (the Windows client IP shows up in the web-app access log) and time (the timeline below overlays every layer).
RBAC: this spans London + Berlin, so only Gary (global) sees the whole picture — Leo sees just the Windows side, Ben just the Berlin side. Cross-domain correlation is a global-analyst capability.

html.p: The four "locations" are subnets in one physical site (no NAT), so the Windows client IP appears verbatim in the web-app access log — the src_ip correlation below is exact.

search.query: index=london_windows EventCode=4624 | eval series="1 · Windows logon" | append [ search index=berlin_web sourcetype=webapp:access src_ip="$ip$" | eval series="2 · Web-app request" ] | append [ search index=berlin_web sourcetype=webapp:probe reachable=1 | eval series="3 · Container reachable" ] | append [ search index=berlin_proxmox sourcetype=proxmox:api endpoint="cluster/resources" type=lxc status=running | eval series="4 · Containers running" ] | timechart span=1m count by series

panel.title: Correlate by source IP — Windows logon ↔ web-app traffic

search.query: index=london_windows EventCode=4624 | rex "Account Name:\s+(?<user>[^\s]+)" | rex "Source Network Address:\s+(?<ip>[0-9.]+)" | stats latest(_time) as logon_time by ip user | append [ search index=berlin_web sourcetype=webapp:access src_ip="$ip$" | stats count as requests, dc(path) as paths, latest(_time) as last_request by src_ip | rename src_ip as ip ] | stats values(user) as "Windows user", max(logon_time) as logon_time, sum(requests) as "App requests", max(last_request) as last_request by ip | eval logon_time=strftime(logon_time,"%F %T"), last_request=strftime(last_request,"%F %T") | rename ip as "Source IP" | table "Source IP" "Windows user" logon_time "App requests" last_request

index=london_windows (EventCode=4624 OR EventCode=4625) | rex "Account Name:\s+(?<user>[^\s]+)" | rex "Source Network Address:\s+(?<src_ip>[0-9.]+)" | eval result=if(EventCode=4624,"success","failure") | table _time host user src_ip result EventCode | sort - _time
index=london_metrics sourcetype=perfmon:cpu | timechart span=1m avg(Value) as "CPU %" by host
index=berlin_web sourcetype=webapp:access src_ip="$ip$" | table _time src_ip method path status action name user_agent host | sort - _time

panel.title: ② Web-app container — requests over time (by path)

search.query: index=berlin_web sourcetype=webapp:access src_ip="$ip$" | timechart span=1m count by path

panel.title: ③ Hypervisor — is the web-app container reachable?

search.query: index=berlin_web sourcetype=webapp:probe | stats latest(reachable) as r latest(latency_ms) as lat latest(http_status) as code | eval status=if(r=1,"UP (".lat." ms, HTTP ".code.")","DOWN") | fields status

index=berlin_proxmox sourcetype=proxmox:api endpoint="cluster/resources" (type=lxc OR type=qemu) | stats latest(status) as Status latest(type) as Type latest(vmid) as VMID by name | rename name as Name | table VMID Type Name Status | sort VMID
index=berlin_metrics sourcetype=linux:metrics host=webapp-berlin | timechart span=1m avg(cpu_pct) as "CPU %" avg(mem_used_pct) as "Mem %"

panel.title: ④ Container — reachability & latency over time

search.query: index=berlin_web sourcetype=webapp:probe | timechart span=1m latest(reachable) as reachable avg(latency_ms) as "latency (ms)"
